about: DFT^P03 charges modeled on a sample: one message per claim, its member's PID from the claim's first line, one FT1 (with any NTE/PR1 after it) per claim line, taken in turn from the sample's FT1s; the segments after the last FT1 (DG1, DRG, IN1...) are the claim's and are written once after its lines.
subject: claims

message.about: The segments every DFT^P03 has (HL7 2.5.1): a charge is an FT1.

units.name: claim
units.missing: The sample has no MSH followed by an FT1: no charge to model claims on.

derive.about: MSH-10, the message control id, is each message's own.
DG1-3.2 is the text of the sample's diagnosis code; a generated code is written without it.
FT1-1, the set id, counts a message's charges from 1.
